name: Vilanova de Sau (Spain)
description: Dark blue field charged at the centre with the white spur rowel of the arms.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 3 October 2016 and the flag was approved on 18 April 2017; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, dark blue, with the white spur rowel of the arms 2/3 of the height and 4/9 of the length at the centre.

features.role: spur rowel of the arms, 2/3 of the height
